about: What the API served in backend/tests/e2e/test_e2e_signed_class_shown.py on real Postgres and ClickHouse (the golden trio, synthetic): the live report's lists of reported variants, the record it signed, the record signed after a class changed. FamilyReportPage.test.tsx renders each. Rebuilt by hand from that test's responses.
